Team Details

Team name: Golden Frame

Team leader name: Rahul Duggal

Theme: Manufacturing — Intelligent Operations & Industrial Efficiency

Problem Statement: After a product change, a factory line can look ready when it is not. Wrong labels, open safety covers, leftover material, or a bad first sample often slip past a rushed visual check. Golden Frame is a phone changeover gate: operators photograph today’s setup, Google AI compares it to the last good run, rules decide HOLD or CLEAR, and a human still taps the final gate. The model never starts the machine.

Slide 2 / 12

Brief about the idea

Golden Frame is a phone-first start check for factories.

Before a line starts a new job, the operator takes five photos of the setup (nest/fixture, label, safety cover, material bin, first finished sample).

Those photos are compared to the last good run (“golden” photos).

Gemini judges look-alike / flags. Document AI reads the printed product code on the label.

A risk table decides HOLD (don’t start) or CLEAR (okay to run). A person still logs the gate.

Demo lines: Line 3 Packaging (A-17) and Cell 2 Electronics (BRD-440).

One-liner: Don’t start until today’s setup looks like the last good run.

Slide 3 / 12

Opportunities

How different is it from existing ideas?

• Not a chatbot. Not mid-run defect cameras. Not another ERP/MES screen.

• Plants already use SAP/ERP, MES, PLC/HMI, Cognex/Keyence vision, label printers — those run the machine or catch defects while product moves.

• They still don’t prove, with photos, that today’s physical setup matches the last good run before start.

How will it solve the problem?

• Forces a short phone check at the dangerous moment: after setup, before first unit.

• Wrong label / open cover / leftover material → HOLD with must-fix + cost of waiting vs escape.

• Fix → recheck → CLEAR. Audit stored for the shift.

USP

• Vision + OCR + rules + human gate on Google Cloud, phone-first, works across packaging and electronics with the same five-slot pattern.

Slide 4 / 12

List of features offered by the solution

• Phone capture of five named frames per line (teach goldens + daily check)

• Live Gemini vision compare against golden album

• Document AI OCR on the label frame for product code (SKU)

• Deterministic risk table: must-fix / warn / retake → HOLD or CLEAR

• Human gate logging (operator / supervisor override with reason)

• Shift history / audit trail (Firestore)

• Cloud Storage for golden + capture evidence (private media via API)

• Multi-line support: packaging + electronics (+ custom lines)

• EN / HI language toggle for operators

• Practice engine for rehearsal without live model calls

• Deployed on Cloud Run (scale-to-zero) with health checks for each service

Process flow diagram or Use-case diagram

Slide 7 / 12

Technologies to be used in the solution

Google Cloud

• Cloud Run — hosts the Next.js app + inspect APIs

• Cloud Storage — golden album + today’s capture evidence

• Firestore — lines, golden metadata, HOLD/CLEAR audit

• Gemini (gemini-3.8-flash) — multimodal vision / flags

• Document AI (OCR processor) — label product-code text

• Cloud Build / Artifact Registry — container build & deploy

App stack

• Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript + React (phone-first UI)

• Risk rules + gate engine in TypeScript (rules beat model prose)

• Vitest unit tests for SKU matching, rules, gate, inspection path

Estimated implementation cost (optional)

One-time implementation (this prototype)

• Build effort: ~2–3 person-weeks for a working Cloud Run MVP (UI + inspect + rules + deploy)

• Hackathon build cost: essentially $0 cash beyond team time (uses GCP free tiers / prepaid AI credits)

• No special hardware — operators use existing phones

Monthly cloud cost (pay-as-you-go estimates)

• Demo / Cup (idle most of the month, <200 inspects): ~$5–25 / month

• Small plant pilot (1–2 lines, ~50 checks/day ≈ 1,500/month): ~$80–250 / month

• Multi-line plant (10 lines, ~300 checks/day): ~$400–1,200 / month (mostly Gemini volume)

• Main meters: Gemini vision per check + Document AI OCR (~$1.50 / 1,000 pages after free tier); Cloud Run/Firestore/Storage often near free at demo scale

Why this is cheap vs the problem

• One avoided bad start / recall can dwarf monthly AI spend; app shows HOLD cost vs escape cost

Prototype Performance report/Benchmarking

• Automated tests: 46 Vitest tests covering SKU/OCR matching, risk table, HOLD/CLEAR gate, inspection path, Document AI helpers, catalog (2 industries × 5 slots), i18n

• Live Cloud Run health: gemini / firestore / storage / documentai all ok

• End-to-end demo path proven: wrong label or open cover → HOLD; fix → CLEAR; audit logged

• Document AI overrides label text when available; Gemini OCR is fallback

• Human-in-the-loop: model never starts equipment — gate tap is required

• Dual industry portability: same engine for Packaging (A-17) and Electronics (BRD-440)
